figures.caption: A first-generation space begins as a shell. The tenant must plan the layout, services, finishes, approvals, and construction needed to make it operational.

figures.caption: A second-generation space can retain useful infrastructure, but existing conditions still need investigation before a new tenant assumes the prior layout will work.

figures.caption: Due diligence turns a promising lease space into a workable fit-out plan by documenting conditions, utility needs, code questions, scope, and budget before construction begins.
